blurb: Manx Pub serves a variety of draught beers including domestic, premium domestic, and imported options. They offer a selection of wines by the glass and bottle, as well as a wide range of whiskeys from different regions. The pub provides lunch and dinner menus with starters, salads, and mains featuring various ingredients and house-made breads.
